record.paper_title: Recent progress and open problems in the Bergman space
record.original_question: Let D be the open unit disk and L^2_a(D) the Bergman space of square-area-integrable analytic functions on D. A sequence A of points in D is an L^2_a(D) zero sequence when some function in L^2_a(D) vanishes precisely on A, counting multiplicities. Characterize exactly which sequences in D are zero sequences for L^2_a(D).

evidence.quote: PROBLEM 2 Characterize the L2a(D) zero sequences.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ denote the open unit disk, and let $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ be the Bergman space consisting of all analytic functions $f : \mathbb{D} \to \mathbb{C}$ such that
$$\|f\|^2 = \int_{\mathbb{D}} |f(z)|^2 \, dA(z) < \infty,$$
where $dA$ denotes Lebesgue area measure on $\mathbb{D}$. A sequence $A = \{a_n\} \subset \mathbb{D}$ (with multiplicities) is called an $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ zero sequence if there exists a non-zero function $f \in L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ whose zero set, counted with multiplicities, coincides exactly with $A$.

Give a complete characterization, in terms of the geometric/potential-theoretic distribution of the points $\{a_n\}$ in $\mathbb{D}$, of those sequences which are $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ zero sequences.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete geometric characterization of zero sequences for the unweighted Bergman space $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ remains open. Significant partial results exist: Horowitz (1974/77) gave sufficient conditions and factorization, Luecking (1996) characterized zero sets for weighted Bergman spaces under certain conditions, and more recent work (e.g., Pau–Peláez–Perälä, 2019, and others) has extended such results to weighted settings with doubling or Bekollé–Bonami weights. However, an exact, intrinsic characterization of $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ zero sequences is still not known.

status_evidence.title: Zero sequences, factorization and sampling measures for weighted Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Zero sets of Bergman spaces induced by certain weights are characterized in the spirit of Luecking's results from 1996; open problems remain regarding sampling measures.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations exist in weighted settings (Luecking, and extensions), but the problem in the unweighted case is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Recent Progress and Open Problems in the Bergman Space
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing characterization of L^2_a(D) zero sequences among the open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Bergman space zero sets, modular forms, von Neumann algebras and ordered groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to investigate Bergman space zero sets.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing research indicates the full characterization is not yet completed.
